decisions.question: Can the local root helper call make_service per request?
decisions.decision: No. It loses persistent native RefUnit ownership. Route both local and remote calls through the fixed persistent broker proxy.

decisions.question: Can real jobs inherit the old512MiB/1CPU/120s fixture plan?
decisions.decision: No. Validate the root-sealed12-field descriptor and explicit reviewed numeric resource plan; fixture behavior remains separate.

decisions.question: Does a new descriptor or local green test enable real execution?
decisions.decision: No. Require native current-boot evidence bound to every real descriptor and complete code closure.

decisions.question: Can arbitrary output below artifacts be exported?
decisions.decision: No. Root revalidates the fixed flat7-name16/32MiB policy after bound stop/cgroup drain; preserve intents and uncertainty on failure.
